subject: Independent Operational Audit and MCAS Achievement Report
overview: The School Committee approved an independent audit of district hiring and personnel protocols following a high-profile staff departure and received a comprehensive report on 2026 MCAS performance. They also recommended the appropriation of over $23 million for the Roberts Elementary School repair project.

items.title: Consent agenda
items.summary: Approved various donations, field trips for the High School Model UN, and minutes from the previous meeting as amended.

items.title: Mustang Moment: OSHA Safety Training
items.summary: Students from the construction and craft laborers program demonstrated fall protection equipment and safety protocols following their completion of OSHA 30-hour certification.

items.title: Personnel and Communication Operational Audit Scope
items.summary: Approved a formal scope for an independent external review of hiring practices and personnel protocols, with a budget not to exceed $30,000, following a high-profile personnel matter. Parents of marching band students provided public comment regarding a recent teacher departure and urged the audit to prioritize student well-being and transparency.

items.title: Special Education Entry Plan
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Kim Clinton presented an entry plan focused on belonging, consistency, and coherence, highlighting a 21.5% special education enrollment and identifying academic achievement at the secondary level as a primary growth area.

items.title: 2026 MCAS Data Report: ELA, Math, and Science
items.summary: Directors presented detailed results showing elementary gains in literacy but significant achievement gaps for secondary students and low-income populations. The district announced a $261,000 grant to acquire high-quality instructional materials for middle school English Language Arts to improve outcomes.

items.title: Roberts School Accelerated Repair Funding
items.summary: Approved a recommendation to the City Council to appropriate $23,547,692 for the Roberts School Accelerated Repair Program.

items.title: Construction Manager at Risk Applications
items.summary: Approved the use of the Construction Manager at Risk (CM-R) process for the Missituk and Brooks elementary school repair projects to expedite state applications.

items.title: Revision to School Calendar Policy
items.summary: Approved revisions to Policy IC to recognize Orthodox Good Friday as an excused absence and align the treatment of Lunar New Year with other cultural holidays.

items.title: Medford High School Project Press Release
items.summary: Approved a joint press release with the City Council expressing unified support for the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Capital Planning Subcommittee Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Facilities and Capital Planning Subcommittee to review and prioritize the district’s outstanding capital needs.
